_note: Governs third-party OAuth apps granted access to org data — the CASB-side counterpart to app-registration-new-credential.kql, which watches Entra ID's audit log for the same underlying risk from the identity side.
description: Flags and optionally revokes OAuth apps with high-risk permission scopes or from unverified publishers.

settings.custom_note: autoRevokeThreshold intentionally set to 'never', not automatic — revoking a live OAuth grant can break a legitimate integration instantly with no warning to the business owner. This is flagged for analyst review, not auto-actioned, same human-in-the-loop discipline as every destructive action in this profile's other SOAR work.
